remarks:
Enjoy lake living in this beautifully remodeled home overlooking Chautauqua Lake. Move-in ready and thoughtfully updated, this property blends modern finishes with timeless charm. The main level features gleaming hardwood floors, fresh paint, and a stunning new kitchen complete with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and large windows that fill the space with natural light while showcasing lake views. A formal dining room, spacious living room, and a full bathroom with a walk-in shower complete the first floor.

Upstairs, you'll find three comfortable bedrooms, each offering abundant natural light, with several enjoying picturesque views of Chautauqua Lake. A second full bathroom with a tub and shower serves the upper level.

Outside, relax on the covered front porch, entertain on the rear patio, or take advantage of your private dock with direct lake access for boating, jet skiing, kayaking, or simply enjoying life on the water. Blacktop parking is conveniently located off Shady Lane.

Whether you're searching for a year-round residence, a weekend getaway, or an investment opportunity, this beautifully updated home offers an exceptional location and the best of Chautauqua Lake living.
